rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 4 November 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 Singapore AI governance benchmark: MAS announced that the Future of Finance Institute has begun operations, with initial work on AI use, including agentic AI, testing, assurance and third-party AI. The initiative is not a new binding requirement, but its future tools and good practices may inform regional governance and vendor-risk monitoring where Singapore operations or shared AI services are material. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. 🟡 Future of Finance Institute Commences Operations, Starting with AI in Finance 🇸🇬 Item ID: item-20261103-daily-exploratory-search-mas-ffi ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Digital banking, AI-enabled services MAS announced on 3 November that Singapore’s public-private Future of Finance Institute (FFI) has commenced operations. Its initial work on AI in finance comprises PathFin.ai, BuildFin.ai and SafeFin.ai, including experience sharing and good practices for deploying agentic AI. MAS says the work will cover practical resources for its AI Risk Management Guidelines, including AI use-case risk assessment, testing and assurance, and third-party AI. This is an industry initiative rather than a new binding instrument or Hong Kong requirement, but may serve as a regional benchmark for AI governance and provider oversight where Singapore operations or shared AI services are material. Source: Future of Finance Institute Commences Operations, Starting with AI in Finance Watch List • Monitor future FFI materials for the scope, status and practical content of its AI guidance, tools and standards.
